# Findings: RS-02 approval-records

## Answer
An approval note is kept with the order record it approves, for the same period, under the official guidance [F-01].

## Findings

### F-01
- claim: The State of Example's guidance says an approval note is kept with the order record it approves, for the same period as the record.
- level: HIGH
- basis: states
- sources: S-01 (https://statutes.example.org/guidance/order-records, retrieved 2026-10-24, primary)
- conflicts: none
